fields.label: Soundtrack Music

fields.description: Follow the sheet keeps the storyboard's own scenes, actions, characters and sounds and only translates them; Creative lets the AI planner write scenes from a brief. A workbook import sets Follow the sheet.
fields.label: Planning

fields.description: Draw in scene lets the image model draw the characters acting like people, from the mascot pictures as references. Paste exact art places the real mascot pictures unchanged, in their own poses. Each scene can override this.
fields.label: Characters
fields.options:
Draw in scene
Paste exact art

fields.description: Full soundtrack lets the video model make voice, effects and music. Sound effects only asks it, in every scene's prompt, for effects alone. Separate effects layer replaces the video model's audio with an effect layer generated per scene, which cannot contain voice or music. Effects + music keeps the scenes' effects and lays one generated music bed under the whole film.
fields.label: Soundtrack
fields.options:
Full soundtrack
Sound effects only
Effects + music
Separate effects layer

fields.description: The delivery tier selects a compatible workflow automatically. Studio upscales the export and interpolates it to 60 fps (slower).
